paper_title: Validating API Design Requirements for Interoperability: A Static Analysis Approach Using OpenAPI
societal_problem: Ensuring high-quality, interoperable, and maintainable APIs is critical for modern enterprises, but the current manual and ad hoc processes for validating API design quality are inefficient, error-prone, and do not scale well. This impacts system evolution, service interoperability, and governance across organizational boundaries.
solution_architecture: The solution is a production-ready API quality validation platform that uses a configurable rule engine to validate OpenAPI specifications against a set of design rules. The platform will support integration with CI/CD pipelines, provide a web-based dashboard for managing rules and reports, and offer IDE plugins for real-time feedback. The tech stack includes Python (for the rule engine), FastAPI (backend API), React.js (frontend), PostgreSQL (database), Docker (containerization), Kubernetes (orchestrating deployments), and GitHub Actions (CI/CD).

tasks.description: Set up the project repository with basic folder structures, initialize Git, and configure Docker for containerization.
Implement a configurable rule engine in Python to validate OpenAPI specifications against predefined rules.
Design and implement a RESTful API using FastAPI to expose endpoints for uploading OpenAPI files, running validations, and retrieving reports.
Develop a PostgreSQL database schema to store rule configurations, validation results, and user data.
Create a React.js frontend for managing API design rules, viewing validation reports, and configuring rule settings.
Integrate the rule engine with the backend API to process OpenAPI files and return validation results.
Develop a feature in the frontend to allow users to enable, disable, or customize API design rules.
Build a reporting module in the frontend to display actionable feedback and traceable validation results.
Integrate the tool with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to enable automated validation of OpenAPI files during development.
Develop an IDE plugin (e.g., for VS Code) to provide real-time API validation feedback during development.
Write unit tests for the rule engine to ensure accuracy and reliability of validation logic.
Implement authentication and authorization for the backend API to secure access to rule configurations and validation reports.
Deploy the application using Docker and Kubernetes for scalability and reliability.
Conduct performance testing to ensure the rule engine and API handle large OpenAPI files efficiently.
Document the API endpoints, frontend usage, and deployment process for end-users and developers.
